plugins.name: video-kit
plugins.description: Two video skills on one engine: narrated explainers (voice as the clock) and beat-cut sizzle reels, drawn in code and rendered with HyperFrames. The agent checks its own frames; you point at what's wrong in a review page, and a studio folder keeps the rules you choose to keep, for every video after. 30 sound effects come free.
